tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.soul_healer: Heal allies within 10 blocks with Instant Health II. Cooldown: 5s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.satchel_of_el: Use: two positive effects. Sneak + use: throw a harmful splash potion. Cooldown: 30s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.totem_of_shie: Aim at ground: deploy a projectile shield. Defaults: 4 blocks, 10s, cooldown 30s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.lightning_rod: Aim at a block: lightning with 5 + 5 HP damage. No cooldown.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.corrupted_see: Poison II for 15s; root enemies for 5s. Cooldown: 25s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.gong_of_weake: Weakness for 30s to enemies within 10 blocks. Cooldown: 45s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.satchel_of_el: Random lightning, fire or levitation around you. Cooldown: 15s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.death_cap_mus: Consumed: Speed II 15s, Strength II 10s; magic self-damage. Cooldown: 10s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.ghost_cloak: Phase through walls, unseen by mobs for 10s. Floors and ceilings remain solid. Cooldown: 30s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.updraft_tome: Stun 4.5s and levitation 3s within 15 blocks. Cooldown: 20s.
tooltip.dungeons_artifacts.boots_of_levi: Toggle levitation, up to 25s. Early stop: half-duration cooldown; full use: 15s.
